recipes.name: Healthier Easy Baked Tilapia
ingredients_raw: 0.25 teaspoon seafood seasoning (such as Old Bay®)
1 (16 ounce) package frozen cauliflower with broccoli and red pepper
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees F). Lightly grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.

Place tilapia fillets in the bottom of the baking dish and season with seafood seasoning. Melt butter with garlic in a small bowl in the microwave, about 30 seconds on medium; pour over fish. Top each fillet with a slice or two of lemon. Arrange the frozen mixed vegetables around the fish, and season lightly with salt and pepper. Cover the dish with aluminum foil.
Bake in the preheated oven until vegetables are tender and fish flakes easily with a fork, 25 to 30 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Healthier Easy Baked Tilapia
raw_recipe.description: Tilapia is quick and easy to prepare. This flavorful dish uses fresh garlic and lemon to highlight the natural flavor of the fish. Accompanied by cauliflower, broccoli, and red pepper - you have a colorful and satisfying meal.

review.reviewBody: This was really great! My family only likes cauliflower raw but I did have a green and yellow bean with carrot mix on hand. This dish was so flavorful! The lemons flavored the vegetables too and it was such a great meal! My kids loved it also! Will DEFINATELY make again but will add more old bay seasoning next time!

Omg, this was an excellent recipe! I don't really enjoy baked fish made from home because I honestly prefer fried fish because it's more filling and tastier in my opinion, but I'm trying to get back on the routine of eating healthy again so I came across this recipe and noticed the ratings (I take ratings literally so they were good and it intrigued me to try it). Well I followed the instructions almost completely, but I made a couple changes! I unthawed 6 frozen tilapia filets and placed them on paper towels and pressed all the excess water out, sprayed the sheet pan with cooking spray and seasoned the pan with old bay rub, placed the fish on the pan and seasoned the top of the fish with more old bay by actually rubbing it in, then heated two tablespoons of unsalted butter with 1 teaspoon of already prepared minced garlic, a little garlic powder, onion powder, salt, pepper and a little all-purpose seasoning and then brushed it over the fish, then I placed thinly sliced lemon circles each filet, then placed frozen California style frozen vegetables around the fish and salted and peppered the fish and vegetables then covered with aluminum foil and baked as directed and I'll tell you, this absolutely came out amazing, my 11 month old son gobbled it up as well as I did and later on my bf ate it and loved it...this is my go to baked fish recipe from now on...thank you!

So I used this recipe as a base and kind of tweaked it but it still turned out tasty and super easy. I added 3 cloves of chopped garlic to cut pieces of cauliflower, broccoli and red pepper. I added about 1/4 cup of chicken broth to help cook the fresh vegetables. I also put the three tilapia filets on top of the vegetables and drizzled olive oil along with the melted butter. Cook time took about 40 minutes but it was quite tasty!

What a great recipe! Instead of using butter I used 1 tablespoon if olive oil, generously sprinkled Bays seasoning, and added dry dill. I had only fresh broccoli, cauliflower, and carrots so I added a little water. Baked 30 minutes ....the veggies took on the flavor of the seasonings..yummy
...Perfect!

My daughter and husband gobbled this up. (My daughter is a typical 10 year-old who finds fish suspicious and rejects my offerings but she LOVED this.)

I did not have the Old Bay so I looked up a substitute and this is what I found: 

2 ½ Tbs. paprika
2 Tbs. salt
2 Tbs. garlic powder
1 Tbs. black pepper
1 Tbs. onion powder
1 Tbs. cayenne pepper
1 Tbs. dried leaf oregano
1 Tbs. dried Thyme

Combine all ingredients thoroughly and store in an airtight jar or container. Makes about 2/3 cup

Served with brown rice (The three minute kind from Trader Joe's) 

Excellent!

Used kosher salt, a wee bit of pepper, thyme, oregano, olive oil, and lemon juice and hacked up 4 small lemons for coverage of the fish. It came out flavouful, flaky, and moist. 

I omitted the veg because we were eating corn on the cob and smoked salt new potatos. 

No complaints from the consumers! 

Thanks for the recipe!

Made this recipe for lunch today but had to make a few adjustments due to lack of ingredients and it was amazing! Didn't have butter so I used "Can't Believe its not butter", didn't have lemon so used lemon juice, and the only frozen vegetables I had were frozen fingerling potatoes and peppers and onions from Schwann's. Also didn't have Old Bay so I used Cajun Blackened Seasoning..... It was delicious.

Easy and great! I sub the spice with paprika, thyme, shallot and lime (what I had). It turned out great! Just add the veggies of your choices. I put frozen butternut squash, pea, corn, green beans and there's plenty of juice which I will use a deep baking dish next time. Thank you!

The only change made was using fresh vegetables (the same ones in the recipe) but roasted them in a separate dish while the fish cooked inside the tinfoil covered dish. I used the same seasonings on the vegetables, which turned out very subtle. Served it to company (very brave, I know!) and everyone loved it.
Easy, fast and really tasty! I use fresh broccoli and skip the butter.
Really great flaky, moist fish. I added garlic salt. Other than that followed recipe and loved it. Use fish that is still frozen, just add 15min to baking time.

I followed the recipe exactly. Very nice dish! Made wild rice as a base very tasty! Only thing, I had to bake it 15 extra minutes to ensure the fish was done because of the veggies and being covered. WILL make again!
It was good but next time I make it will have to add something to it for some zest...it was a little bland for my taste.

I’ve made this a few times for a quick dinner. The first few times I followed the recipe to the tee. I made it tonight and used frozen peas and carrots to change it up, especially since my son loves peas.
I was so happy with the ease of this dish! I made it exactly as stated and my family and I loved it!! Will make again!!
This is a prefect ten for my family. I am going to make this dish often. Thanks to MarketHealthy on this recipe.

Wow....just made this. It's such a great recipe and I can't stress enough how easy it was to make. I used frozen stir fry veggies and followed the recipe as is. I made more since I'm starting to meal prep. I served it over Quinoa and Brown Rice and a side of Italian seasoned roasted potatoes. It reminds me of a dish I had at a restaurant. I'd give it 10 stars if I could. Thanks for posting!
Love this fish cooked this way. This is a keeper for me and my family. Really tasty and flavorful. Only made the fish tho. Will try the veggies with another time.

I used fresh broccoli and bell peppers because that's what I had. In my opinion it still came out great. My in-laws are healthy eaters and they gave nothing but raves so it was definitely a win in my book!
No changes and I will make it again.
